feeds.title: European Association for People Management
feeds.description: The EAPM is a network association and the body for European human resource management and the people profession. It forms a European umbrella body of national HR-related organizations and facilitates experience exchange without profit or commercial gain. It is a purely professional, not-for-profit organization independent of all employers, trade unions, and state or political bodies.
